name: Deepest Swimming Pool Ever Obby
desc:
Welcome to Deepest Swimming Pool Ever Obby! A massive vertical swim challenge that takes you far below the surface.

🚶‍♂️ Start at the edge and swim straight down
💦 Pass through colorful pool layers and checkpoints
🌟 Beat the depth and reach the legendary underwater zone
🏝️ Find paradise at the bottom with fun jumps and surprises!

No tricks, no traps, just you, the water, and the deepest pool on Roblox.
How low can you go?
